rows.grounds: locative of place; site in the enumerated list
locative of place; a rest-house or water-shed
locative of compound ārāma-ādi; 'garden and so forth'

items.question: Which additional places qualify as sites for such occurrences?
premises: A monastery is named as a possible site.
A water-shed is named as a possible site.
A garden and similar places are included as alternatives.
items.inference: The enumerated occurrences may also take place in monasteries, water-sheds, gardens, or similar locations.
uncertainties: The exact scope of ārāmādi ('garden etc.') is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Or in a monastery, in a water-shed, or in a garden and such places, or also elsewhere.
